audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers attribute Quinn's blind to her E dash. full.tldr, winCon, enemyWin and breakdown.cooldowns all call the ability "Vault (Dash/Blind)", and breakdown.cooldowns spells it out: "Quinn Vault: Dashes to a target, knocks back, and blinds their next attacks." The content layer repeats it in early, spikes[0].text, whys[0], wants.foe[0], late and whys[6].
audit.why: The blind is Blinding Assault, her Q — 'calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision', 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, range 1025. Vault (E) is a 12/11/10/9/8s dash at 675 that damages, slows and briefly interrupts, then drops her back at attack range. It does not blind. This is the most consequential error in my whole slice because Nasus's entire damage output is Siphoning Strike, an auto-attack reset: a blind makes a fully stacked Q whiff. Believing the blind only arrives attached to a melee-range dash means the player will hold their stacked Q for the wrong cue and lose it to a Q thrown from 1025 away, twice as far as Wither reaches.
audit.corrected: Blinding Assault (Q) is the blind, at 1025 range on an 11s cooldown. Vault (E) is the dash and her only escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: Her mobility is credited to the passive — early says "her passive Harrier gives her a move-speed burst", and spikes[0].text, whys[0], wants.foe[1], late and whys[6] all repeat "Harrier move speed".
audit.why: Harrier is a mark that makes Quinn's first basic attack against the marked target deal bonus physical damage. It grants no movement speed at all. The attack speed and move speed come from Heightened Senses (W), and only after she attacks a Harrier-marked target — so it is a two-step chain, mark then hit, not a free passive burst. That matters for timing: the speed arrives after she commits an attack, which is the moment Wither is worth spending.
audit.corrected: Harrier is a bonus-damage mark; Heightened Senses (W) pays the attack and move speed once she hits a marked target.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and it is right — mid says "bait the E vault first, because once it's down she can't escape" without ever saying how long down lasts.
audit.why: Vault is 12/11/10/9/8s and is her only disengage. At rank 1 a spent Vault leaves her walking for twelve seconds, which is the entire basis of the bait advice the text already gives and the only realistic kill window a champion with no dash and no gap-closer will ever get here.
audit.corrected: Attach the 12s figure to the bait-the-Vault instruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text contains the garbled clause "but she can E-sidestep nothing and just walk away with nimble move speed".
audit.why: The sentence does not parse and conveys no instruction. It reads like a half-finished edit.
audit.corrected: Replace with the concrete Vault-cooldown window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Behind Enemy Lines is never named, though content.late is entirely about her leaving the lane.
audit.why: The roam threat the section describes is a specific ability — a fast out-of-combat travel channel that ends in Skystrike. Naming it lets the player understand why Quinn vanishes from the map and why tracking her is a jungle and mid problem, not just a top-lane one.
audit.corrected: Name Behind Enemy Lines as the roam engine.

audit.why: 45.30% over 351 games with HARD / 7-10 and a chart giving Quinn everything except level 6. That is consistent, and this is the one matchup in my slice where the pessimistic framing is earned.

edits.before: Quinn owns levels 1-3 completely. Her E vault knocks you back, blinds your next Q auto, and her passive Harrier gives her a move-speed burst to skip away before you can punish — so every time you step up to stack a cannon, you eat poke and get nothing. Don't chase her; you cannot catch a Quinn. Last-hit with Spirit Fire from max range to grab stacks safely and accept that she's ahead. Wither at 3 is your only lock-down tool, but she has the move speed to bait it out and walk off.
edits.after: Quinn owns levels 1-3 completely. Get the abilities straight: Blinding Assault (Q) is the blind and it reaches 1025, while Vault (E) is the dash that slows you and drops her back at range. Her speed comes from Heightened Senses, which pays attack and move speed once she hits a Harrier-marked target. Never spend a stacked Q while blinded. Last-hit with Spirit Fire from max range and accept she is ahead; Wither at 3 is your only lock.

edits.before: This stays her lane. Levels 4-5 she pokes you off the wave with autos and Harrier procs and you simply hoard stacks under tower with Spirit Fire, playing not to die. Level 6 is your one real swing: if she gets greedy and poke-steps into melee range, Fury of the Sands plus an instant Wither slow lets you stick and grind one kill — bait the E vault first, because once it's down she can't escape your ult range. But if she plays the lane honestly and kites, you don't own anything here.
edits.after: This stays her lane. Levels 4-5 she pokes you off the wave with autos and Harrier procs and you hoard stacks under tower with Spirit Fire, playing not to die. Level 6 is your one real swing: if she poke-steps into melee range, Fury of the Sands plus an instant Wither lets you stick and grind one kill — bait Vault first, because at 12s rank 1 a spent dash leaves her nothing to escape your ult range with. If she kites honestly, you own nothing here.

edits.before: She doesn't even need to win lane — Quinn just leaves. Her roams snowball mid and bot while you're stuck farming, and even when you finally have stacks plus ult, a fed Quinn kites your immobile single-target ult with E knockback, blind, and Harrier move speed and never lets you connect. Your only path is to make your stacks matter as a splitpush threat she's forced to answer, dragging her off the map so your team plays 5v4 elsewhere. Don't expect to catch her in a straight 1v1 — you won't.
edits.after: She doesn't even need to win lane — Quinn just leaves. Behind Enemy Lines makes her a permanent roam threat, snowballing mid and bot while you're stuck farming, and even once you have stacks plus ult a fed Quinn kites you with Vault, Blinding Assault and Heightened Senses speed. Your only path is to make your stacks matter as a splitpush threat she's forced to answer, dragging her off the map so your team plays 5v4 elsewhere. You won't catch her 1v1.

notes: This was the weakest entry in my slice and got the most work. The blind-on-the-dash error ran through both layers including the ability's display name in full.tldr, winCon, enemyWin and breakdown.cooldowns, so the fix has to land in the full layer or the loading screen keeps saying "Vault (Dash/Blind)". Worth checking whether that label is generated from a shared source rather than typed per matchup — if so, every champion's Quinn entry carries it. I did not touch full.loading, which also contains the wrong label, because it is a concatenation of strings I am already correcting and I could not tell whether it is rebuilt from them. The packet's suspectName "Use Spirit Fire" in wants.you[1] is a false positive — Nasus's own E.
